name: Balm
overview: The Bible presents balm as a valuable medicinal substance, often associated with healing and restoration, as seen in references to the balm of Gilead (Jeremiah 8:22, 46:11, 51:8). It was a prized commodity traded by merchants from Israel and Judah (Ezekiel 27:17) and was considered a precious gift, symbolizing care and provision (Genesis 37:25; 43:11). Despite its healing properties, Scripture also acknowledges that balm alone cannot cure spiritual or deep-rooted wounds, highlighting the need for divine intervention.
